description: Run one operation by name with its arguments. mzizi_search lists operations with their arguments, the permission each needs and whether you may run it. Operations: get_component, list_components, get_tokens, get_architecture, get_doctrine, get_skills, check_accessibility, list_crates, describe, docs_search_mzizi, docs_query_docs_filesystem_mzizi, docs_submit_feedback. Reads need no account; the fundi operation needs sign-in, and a refusal names the permission it needs and how to sign in. The result is the operation's own answer. The earlier tool names (mzizi_get_component and the rest) are accepted as operation names.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments, as its `arguments` schema in mzizi_search states them. Omit for none.

name: mzizi_execute
title: Run a Mzizi operation
